authority_limits.parallel_assignments: none unless the Hokage changes the order

records.return_condition: Hokage revocation, team dissolution, lawful reassignment, retirement, death, or incapacity

rule: Intact formation assignments retain source ownership, home formation, standards and history. Raw personnel assignments retain source accounting/home claims and may remain unorganized until lawful formation. Aggregate force-slice assignments grant bounded command over a conserved headcount from a named source availability class. Assignment changes authority, not ownership.
return_rule: Return intact formations or surviving raw-personnel claims to the source chain; preserve casualties, injuries, experience, morale/cohesion, lawful promotions, equipment loss and history; dissolve receiving-only temporary arrangements; then invoke source reconstitution.
